sayLines.line: 🧭 A person, maybe 20s is back from the south. "It's... different out there. I'll tell you about it." (Ask them what they saw.)
Gina is staying at Haven as the camp healer now — tending the sick instead of ranging out.
📓 Codex: Gina taught Omar Herbal Medicine.
✦ Gina has found something — Field Pharmacy. Days of field_medicine and herbal_remedy side by side, and now they move as one. (field_pharmacy: villager synergy discovered)

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.

You have Wound Fever. Wound Fever — infection in an open cut. Clean it properly (field medicine, triage), poultice it (herbal), or hit it with antibiotics. All three work. (Antibiotics would end it.) The ruins to the north sometimes still hold medicine cabinets — worth searching. — diagnosed by Gina.
Omar came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.

Adil is staying at Haven as the camp healer now — tending the sick instead of ranging out.

💛 You hold Spare Socks. The flood year, three days in wet boots. Your feet went white and strange. The medic packed them with yarrow and told you: dry socks are civilization. Never again, you said. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are still yours. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)
